DIAGNOSIS READY: Venous Stasis Ulcer secondary to Chronic Venous Insufficiency.

Based on your history of DVT, family history, confirmed venous reflux on ultrasound, and the chronic nature of the right lower leg wound with swelling, the diagnosis is a venous stasis ulcer. The photos I requested will help confirm the presence of typical signs like hyperpigmentation or lipodermatosclerosis around the ankle.
